ex.en: I study comparative religion in the arts faculty of the University of Turku.
ex.zh: 我在圖爾庫大學人文學院研讀比較宗教學。

ex.en: The faculty meet once a month to discuss the program.
ex.zh: 全體教師每月開一次會討論課程。

faculty.en: a group of university departments, or all the teachers at a school

ex.en: At 90, she still has all her faculties.
ex.zh: 她九十歲了，各項身心機能仍然健全。

ex.en: He has a faculty for learning languages.
ex.zh: 他很有學語言的天分。

faculty.en: a natural ability of the body or mind

ex.en: She failed the examination and I was greatly disappointed.
ex.zh: 她考試沒過，讓我非常失望。

ex.en: Failing the examination means waiting for another year.
ex.zh: 考試不及格就得再等一年。

fail.en: to not reach the level needed to pass a test

ex.en: After all his efforts, he also failed this time.
ex.zh: 他雖然很努力，這次還是失敗了。

ex.en: The plan failed because we didn't have enough money.
ex.zh: 這個計畫因為錢不夠而失敗了。

fail.en: to not succeed in what you try to do

fail.zh: never fail to / without fail：一定、從不間斷

ex.en: Nancy never fails to write to me once a month.
ex.zh: 南西每個月一定會寫信給我。

ex.en: The train will arrive on time without fail.
ex.zh: 火車一定會準時到。

fail.en: used to say that someone always does something or something will certainly happen

ex.en: I got your fax the other day.
ex.zh: 我前幾天收到了你的傳真。

ex.en: I have no idea of how to send a fax.
ex.zh: 我完全不知道怎麼發傳真。

ex.en: I don't know about the past, but now we have faxes and emails.
ex.zh: 我不知道以前怎樣，但現在我們有傳真和電子郵件。

fax.en: a copy of a document sent by phone line, or the machine that sends it

ex.en: Could you fax me the contract this afternoon?
ex.zh: 你今天下午可以把合約傳真給我嗎？

ex.en: I faxed the order form to the supplier.
ex.zh: 我把訂購單傳真給供應商了。

fax.en: to send a copy of a document through a phone line

ex.en: The fire was caused by faulty wiring.
ex.zh: 這場火災是線路故障引起的。

ex.en: We will replace any faulty products for free.
ex.zh: 任何有瑕疵的產品我們都會免費更換。

faulty.en: not working properly because of a problem

ex.en: His argument is based on faulty logic.
ex.zh: 他的論點建立在錯誤的邏輯上。

ex.en: Faulty data led to the wrong conclusion.
ex.zh: 錯誤的資料導致了錯誤的結論。

ex.en: Fasten your seat belt, please.
ex.zh: 請繫好安全帶。

ex.en: Fasten your seat belt at all times.
ex.zh: 請隨時繫好安全帶。

ex.en: Fasten the papers together with a clip.
ex.zh: 用夾子把文件固定在一起。

fasten.en: to close or join something firmly so it stays in place

ex.en: Please familiarize yourself with the safety rules.
ex.zh: 請先熟悉安全規定。

ex.en: New employees need time to familiarize themselves with the system.
ex.zh: 新進員工需要時間熟悉這套系統。

familiarize.en: to learn about something until you know it well

ex.en: Thanks to the favorable wind, we soon reached the island.
ex.zh: 多虧順風，我們很快就抵達了那座島。

ex.en: Circumstances are entirely favorable to us.
ex.zh: 情勢對我們完全有利。

favorable.en: good for you and likely to help you succeed

ex.en: His comments about the book were favorable.
ex.zh: 他對這本書的評價很正面。

ex.en: The new product received favorable reviews.
ex.zh: 新產品獲得好評。

favorable.en: showing that you like or approve of something

ex.en: The dress is made of a thin fabric.
ex.zh: 這件洋裝是用薄布料做的。

ex.en: These fabrics are made of pure wool.
ex.zh: 這些布料是純羊毛的。

ex.en: Do we still have this fabric?
ex.zh: 我們還有這種布料嗎？

fabric.en: cloth used for making clothes and other things

ex.en: A farewell party was held for Mr. Jones.
ex.zh: 大家為瓊斯先生辦了一場歡送會。

ex.en: I got a farewell present from everyone.
ex.zh: 大家送了我一份歡送禮物。

ex.en: He said farewell and left.
ex.zh: 他道別後就離開了。

ex.en: Familiarity with Excel is required for this job.
ex.zh: 這份工作需要熟悉 Excel。

ex.en: His familiarity with the local market helped us a lot.
ex.zh: 他對當地市場的熟悉幫了我們很大的忙。

familiarity.en: good knowledge of something or experience with it

ex.en: The report must be accurate and factual.
ex.zh: 報告必須準確且符合事實。

ex.en: Please check the article for factual errors.
ex.zh: 請檢查這篇文章是否有事實錯誤。

factual.en: based on facts and true things

ex.en: She had to accept her fate.
ex.zh: 她只能接受自己的命運。

ex.en: God knows what their fate will be.
ex.zh: 天曉得他們的命運會如何。

ex.en: This is your fate.
ex.zh: 這是你的命運。

fate.en: the power that is believed to control what happens in life

ex.en: Test pilots are constantly tempting fate.
ex.zh: 試飛員總是在冒險。

ex.en: Don't tempt fate by driving without insurance.
ex.zh: 別冒險開沒保險的車。

fate.en: to do something risky that could lead to bad luck

ex.en: The party is divided into two factions.
ex.zh: 這個政黨分成兩個派系。

ex.en: Rival factions within the company fought over the budget.
ex.zh: 公司內部對立的派系為了預算爭執不休。

faction.en: a small group within a larger group that has different ideas

ex.en: In all fairness, he did do his best.
ex.zh: 平心而論，他真的盡力了。

ex.en: Employees care about fairness in pay.
ex.zh: 員工很在意薪資是否公平。

ex.en: Some people questioned the fairness of the process.
ex.zh: 有些人質疑這個流程的公正性。

fairness.en: the quality of treating everyone in a reasonable and equal way

ex.en: Two families live in that house.
ex.zh: 那棟房子住了兩戶人家。

ex.en: Apart from my sister, my family doesn't watch TV.
ex.zh: 除了我妹妹，我家人都不看電視。

ex.en: Monopoly is a popular game for families to play.
ex.zh: 大富翁是很受家庭歡迎的遊戲。

family.en: a group of people who are related, such as parents and children

ex.en: We had a family dinner on Sunday.
ex.zh: 我們星期天吃了一頓家庭聚餐。

ex.en: This is a family restaurant.
ex.zh: 這是一家家庭式餐廳。

family.en: of parents and children, or good for all ages

ex.en: A face with too much make up looks strange.
ex.zh: 妝化得太濃，臉看起來會很怪。

ex.en: She had a big smile on her face.
ex.zh: 她臉上帶著燦爛的笑容。

face.en: the front part of the head with the eyes, nose and mouth

ex.en: We were faced with an unusual situation because of the accident.
ex.zh: 因為那場事故，我們面臨了不尋常的狀況。

ex.en: Half a million children still face malnutrition in Niger.
ex.zh: 在尼日仍有五十萬名兒童面臨營養不良。

face.en: to deal with a difficult situation

ex.en: My room faces south, which makes it sunny and very comfortable.
ex.zh: 我的房間朝南，陽光充足，非常舒適。

ex.en: I'd like a room facing the garden.
ex.zh: 我想要一間面向花園的房間。

face.en: to be turned toward a certain direction

ex.en: The first peaches were already falling from the tree.
ex.zh: 第一批桃子已經從樹上掉下來了。

ex.en: Be careful not to fall on the ice.
ex.zh: 小心別在冰上跌倒。

fall.en: to move down toward the ground

ex.en: The barometer is falling. It is going to rain.
ex.zh: 氣壓計的數值在下降，快下雨了。

ex.en: Prices fell sharply last month.
ex.zh: 上個月價格大幅下跌。

fall.en: to become lower in amount or level

ex.en: These green leaves turn red or yellow in fall.
ex.zh: 這些綠葉到了秋天會變成紅色或黃色。

ex.en: We're planning a trip to Japan this fall.
ex.zh: 我們打算今年秋天去日本旅行。

fall.en: the season between summer and winter

ex.en: The prince fell in love with a woodcutter's daughter.
ex.zh: 王子愛上了樵夫的女兒。

ex.en: No, until now she has never fallen in love.
ex.zh: 沒有，她到現在都還沒談過戀愛。

ex.en: My father will possibly come on the next train.
ex.zh: 我父親可能會搭下一班火車來。

ex.en: I'm sorry to hear that your father passed away.
ex.zh: 聽到你父親過世的消息，我很難過。

ex.en: I have a friend whose father is a teacher.
ex.zh: 我有個朋友，他父親是老師。

father.en: a man who has a child

ex.en: He is often called the father of modern computing.
ex.zh: 他常被稱為現代電腦之父。

ex.en: Edison is sometimes called the father of the light bulb.
ex.zh: 愛迪生有時被稱為電燈泡之父。

father.en: a man who starts or first develops something important

ex.en: The fastest way to travel is by plane.
ex.zh: 搭飛機是最快的旅行方式。

ex.en: The service in this restaurant is none too fast.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳的上菜速度一點也不快。

ex.en: We need a fast internet connection.
ex.zh: 我們需要快速的網路連線。

fast.en: moving or happening at high speed

ex.en: Generally speaking, men can run faster than women can.
ex.zh: 一般來說，男人跑得比女人快。

ex.en: The professor spoke too fast for anyone to understand.
ex.zh: 那位教授講得太快，沒有人聽得懂。

ex.en: A dog can run faster than a man can.
ex.zh: 狗跑得比人快。

fast.en: at high speed or in a short time

ex.en: When was the last time you fasted?
ex.zh: 你上次禁食是什麼時候？

ex.en: You must fast for eight hours before the test.
ex.zh: 檢查前必須禁食八小時。

fast.en: to eat no food for a period of time, often for religious reasons

ex.en: Honesty was the most important factor in his success.
ex.zh: 誠實是他成功最重要的因素。

ex.en: Several factors operated to help prices go up.
ex.zh: 物價上漲是多種因素造成的。

ex.en: Capital, land and labor are the three key factors of production.
ex.zh: 資本、土地和勞力是生產的三大要素。

factor.en: one of the things that cause or influence a result

ex.en: My favorite pastime is strolling along the shore.
ex.zh: 我閒暇時最喜歡沿著海邊散步。

ex.en: Graham Greene is a favorite author of mine.
ex.zh: 格雷安·葛林是我最喜歡的作家之一。

ex.en: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.
ex.zh: 湯姆把一半薪水捐給他最喜歡的慈善機構。

favorite.en: liked more than all others of the same kind

ex.en: This song is my favorite.
ex.zh: 這首歌是我的最愛。

ex.en: Pizza is always a favorite with kids.
ex.zh: 披薩一向很受小孩喜愛。

favorite.en: the person or thing that you like best

ex.en: Kyoto is famous for its shrines and temples.
ex.zh: 京都以神社和寺廟聞名。

ex.en: She will be a famous artist in the future.
ex.zh: 她將來會成為有名的藝術家。

ex.en: Besides being an actress, she was a famous painter.
ex.zh: 她除了是演員，也是一位有名的畫家。

ex.en: It's not fair! I have to do the hard work!
ex.zh: 這不公平！為什麼粗活都要我做？

ex.en: It doesn't seem very fair to treat him like this.
ex.zh: 這樣對待他好像不太公平。

ex.en: It's not fair to attribute your failure to your parents.
ex.zh: 把你的失敗怪到父母頭上是不公平的。

fair.en: treating everyone in a reasonable and equal way

ex.en: Where are all the people going? Is there a fair?
ex.zh: 大家都去哪裡了？有市集嗎？

ex.en: Our company will attend the trade fair in Taipei.
ex.zh: 我們公司會參加台北的商展。

ex.en: I found a new job at the career fair.
ex.zh: 我在就業博覽會找到新工作。

fair.en: an event where people show or sell things and there are games

fair.zh: 相當的、尚可的；（膚色）白皙的

ex.en: He has a fair chance of getting the job.
ex.zh: 他得到這份工作的機會還不小。

ex.en: She has fair skin and blond hair.
ex.zh: 她皮膚白皙、頭髮金黃。

fair.en: quite good or large, or having light skin

ex.en: All of his family work on a farm.
ex.zh: 他全家都在農場工作。

ex.en: Tom and Mary own a small organic farm.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗擁有一座小型有機農場。

ex.en: I live on a farm not too far from Boston.
ex.zh: 我住在離波士頓不遠的一座農場。

farm.en: an area of land used for growing crops or keeping animals

ex.en: His family has farmed this land for generations.
ex.zh: 他家世世代代都在這塊地上務農。

ex.en: They farm rice and vegetables.
ex.zh: 他們種稻米和蔬菜。

farm.en: to grow crops or keep animals on land

ex.en: He said to me, "Please, do me a favor."
ex.zh: 他對我說：「請幫我一個忙。」

ex.en: I want you guys to do me a favor.
ex.zh: 我想請你們幫我一個忙。

ex.en: I have a favor to ask of you.
ex.zh: 我有件事想請你幫忙。

favor.en: something kind that you do to help someone

ex.en: I am in favor of your proposal.
ex.zh: 我贊成你的提議。

ex.en: The balance of public opinion remains in his favor.
ex.zh: 輿論整體上仍對他有利。

ex.en: Most of the staff are in favor of the new policy.
ex.zh: 大部分員工贊成新政策。

favor.en: supporting or agreeing with an idea or plan

ex.en: The new rules favor large companies.
ex.zh: 新規定對大公司有利。

ex.en: Most voters favor lower taxes.
ex.zh: 大部分選民支持減稅。

favor.en: to like or support one thing more than others, or to give it an advantage

ex.en: There seem to be several reasons for his failure.
ex.zh: 他的失敗似乎有好幾個原因。

ex.en: Even the most carefully made plans frequently result in failure.
ex.zh: 即使是最周詳的計畫也常常失敗。

ex.en: It's not fair to attribute your failure to your parents.
ex.zh: 把你的失敗怪到父母頭上是不公平的。

ex.en: The flight was delayed due to an engine failure.
ex.zh: 班機因引擎故障而延誤。

ex.en: A power failure shut down the factory.
ex.zh: 停電讓工廠停工。

failure.en: a situation in which a machine or body part stops working

ex.en: His failure to reply annoyed the client.
ex.zh: 他沒有回覆，讓客戶很不高興。

ex.en: Failure to pay on time will result in a fee.
ex.zh: 未準時付款將收取費用。

failure.en: the fact of not doing something that you should do

ex.en: What sort of coats are in fashion this year?
ex.zh: 今年流行什麼款式的外套？

ex.en: This style of hat is now in fashion.
ex.zh: 這種款式的帽子現在很流行。

ex.en: She knows a lot about the latest fashions.
ex.zh: 她對最新的流行時尚很了解。

fashion.en: the style of clothes and other things that is popular at a certain time

ex.en: Please line up in an orderly fashion.
ex.zh: 請依序排好隊。

ex.en: He finished the work in a timely fashion.
ex.zh: 他及時完成了工作。

fashion.en: the way in which something is done

familiar.zh: 熟悉的、通曉的（be familiar with）

ex.en: Are you familiar with the rules of soccer?
ex.zh: 你熟悉足球規則嗎？

ex.en: Is that an area you are familiar with?
ex.zh: 你熟悉這個領域嗎？

ex.en: I am familiar with the author's name.
ex.zh: 我對這位作者的名字很熟悉。

familiar.zh: 眼熟的、耳熟的；常見的（be familiar to）

ex.en: Your face looks familiar.
ex.zh: 你看起來很眼熟。

ex.en: That name sounds familiar to me.
ex.zh: 那個名字我聽起來很耳熟。

familiar.en: easy to recognize because you have seen or heard it before

ex.en: I'm fairly certain Tom lives on Park Street.
ex.zh: 我相當確定湯姆住在公園街。

ex.en: I'm fairly confident that I can do that.
ex.zh: 我相當有信心能做到。

ex.en: That sounds like a fairly good proposal.
ex.zh: 這聽起來是個相當不錯的提案。

ex.en: All employees should be treated fairly.
ex.zh: 所有員工都應該受到公平對待。

ex.en: The prize money was divided fairly.
ex.zh: 獎金分配得很公平。

fairly.en: in a way that is reasonable and equal for everyone

ex.en: Farmers are busy working in the field.
ex.zh: 農夫們在田裡忙著工作。

ex.en: Farmers are very busy during the harvest.
ex.zh: 農夫在收成季節非常忙碌。

ex.en: She borrowed a saw from the farmer.
ex.zh: 她向農夫借了一把鋸子。

farmer.en: a person who grows crops or raises animals on land

ex.en: He is fatter than when I last saw him.
ex.zh: 他比我上次見到他時胖了一些。

ex.en: The more chocolate you eat, the fatter you'll get.
ex.zh: 巧克力吃得越多，就會越胖。

ex.en: Were you fat when you were in high school?
ex.zh: 你高中的時候胖嗎？

fat.en: having a lot of flesh on the body

ex.en: This yogurt is low in fat.
ex.zh: 這款優格的脂肪含量很低。

ex.en: Try to cut down on fat and sugar.
ex.zh: 盡量減少脂肪和糖的攝取。

fat.en: a soft substance found in animals, plants and food

ex.en: I have complete faith in my doctor.
ex.zh: 我完全信任我的醫生。

ex.en: My faith in the next generation is increasing.
ex.zh: 我對下一代越來越有信心了。

ex.en: He had lost all faith in his ability to succeed.
ex.zh: 他對自己能成功已經完全失去信心。

faith.en: a strong feeling that someone or something can be trusted

ex.en: People of all faiths are welcome here.
ex.zh: 這裡歡迎各種宗教信仰的人。

ex.en: Her faith helped her through difficult times.
ex.zh: 她的信仰幫助她度過難關。

faith.en: a belief in a god, or a particular religion

ex.en: It's not your fault that the project was delayed.
ex.zh: 專案延誤不是你的錯。

ex.en: The accident was the driver's fault.
ex.zh: 那場事故是司機的責任。

fault.en: the blame for something bad that happened

ex.en: I love him none the less for his faults.
ex.zh: 儘管他有缺點，我還是一樣愛他。

ex.en: I love her all the more for her faults.
ex.zh: 她的缺點反而讓我更愛她。

fault.en: a weak point or bad part of someone or something

ex.en: A technical fault caused the delay.
ex.zh: 技術故障造成了延誤。

ex.en: The engineers found a fault in the system.
ex.zh: 工程師在系統中發現了一個故障。

fault.en: a problem that stops a machine from working properly

ex.en: Nothing is easier than finding fault with others.
ex.zh: 沒有什麼比挑別人毛病更容易的事了。

ex.en: He is constantly finding fault with other people.
ex.zh: 他老是挑別人的毛病。

fault.en: to complain about small mistakes or bad points

ex.en: It turned out that the rumor was false.
ex.zh: 結果那個謠言是假的。

ex.en: Please mark each statement true or false.
ex.zh: 請判斷每個敘述是對還是錯。

ex.en: He gave a false name to the police.
ex.zh: 他向警方報了假名。

ex.en: Don't make false promises to customers.
ex.zh: 不要對顧客做出不實的承諾。

false.en: not real, but made to look real in order to trick people

ex.en: Slavic languages fascinate me.
ex.zh: 斯拉夫語言讓我著迷。

ex.en: Young children are often fascinated by science.
ex.zh: 小孩子常常對科學很著迷。

ex.en: I was fascinated by her sweet voice.
ex.zh: 我被她甜美的嗓音迷住了。

ex.en: Although he is not a singer, his singing voice is fantastic.
ex.zh: 他雖然不是歌手，但歌聲非常棒。

ex.en: In order to give him a surprise on his birthday, I prepared a fantastic cake.
ex.zh: 為了在他生日給他驚喜，我準備了一個超棒的蛋糕。

ex.en: You did a fantastic job on the presentation.
ex.zh: 你的簡報做得太棒了。

ex.en: The rocks are weathered into fantastic forms.
ex.zh: 岩石經過風化，形成了各種奇特的形狀。

ex.en: The book is full of fantastic creatures.
ex.zh: 這本書裡充滿了奇幻生物。

fantastic.en: strange and imaginary, as if from a dream

ex.en: How about we go to a slightly fancier restaurant?
ex.zh: 我們去一家稍微高級一點的餐廳怎麼樣？

ex.en: Tom and Mary stayed at a fancy hotel.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗住在一間高級飯店。

ex.en: I don't need a fancy phone, just a reliable one.
ex.zh: 我不需要很花俏的手機，只要好用就行。

fancy.en: special, expensive or decorated in a way that is not simple

ex.en: We're going down the pub. Do you fancy coming?
ex.zh: 我們要去酒吧，你想一起來嗎？

ex.en: Do you fancy a cup of tea?
ex.zh: 你想喝杯茶嗎？

ex.en: He fancies himself as an artist.
ex.zh: 他自認為是個藝術家。

ex.en: She fancies herself a good singer.
ex.zh: 她自以為很會唱歌。

fancy.en: to think that you are a certain kind of person

ex.en: The curtains faded in the sun.
ex.zh: 窗簾被太陽曬到褪色了。

ex.en: These jeans won't fade in the wash.
ex.zh: 這條牛仔褲洗了不會褪色。

fade.en: to lose color and become less bright

ex.en: Her beauty will fade in time.
ex.zh: 她的美貌終將隨時間消逝。

ex.en: His hopes faded.
ex.zh: 他的希望漸漸破滅了。

ex.en: The drum faded away.
ex.zh: 鼓聲漸漸消失了。

fade.en: to slowly become weaker and then disappear

ex.en: He carried out the scheme faithfully.
ex.zh: 他忠實地執行了這項計畫。

ex.en: He has served the company faithfully for 30 years.
ex.zh: 他忠心耿耿地為公司服務了三十年。

ex.en: She faithfully visits her grandmother every Sunday.
ex.zh: 她每週日都固定去探望奶奶。

faithfully.en: in a loyal way, or exactly as it should be done

faithfully.zh: Yours faithfully：謹啟（英式正式書信結尾，不知收件人姓名時用）

ex.en: Formal letters often end with "Yours faithfully."
ex.zh: 正式信件常以「Yours faithfully（謹啟）」結尾。

ex.en: Use "Yours faithfully" if you don't know the recipient's name.
ex.zh: 如果不知道收件人的名字，就用「Yours faithfully」結尾。

faithfully.en: a polite way to end a formal letter when you do not know the name of the person

ex.en: We discussed every facet of the project.
ex.zh: 我們討論了這個專案的每個層面。

ex.en: Customer service is an important facet of our business.
ex.zh: 客戶服務是我們業務中很重要的一環。

facet.en: one of the parts or sides of something

ex.en: The diamond has 58 facets.
ex.zh: 這顆鑽石有 58 個切割面。

ex.en: Light reflects off each facet of the crystal.
ex.zh: 光線從水晶的每個刻面反射出來。

facet.en: one of the flat surfaces cut on a jewel

ex.en: The factorial of 5 is 120.
ex.zh: 5 的階乘是 120。

ex.en: Write a program that calculates the factorial of a number.
ex.zh: 寫一個計算數字階乘的程式。

factorial.en: the result of multiplying a whole number by all the smaller whole numbers down to one

ex.en: What with fatigue and lack of sleep, he has fallen ill at last.
ex.zh: 他又累又睡眠不足，最後終於病倒了。

ex.en: Fatigue is a common symptom of the flu.
ex.zh: 疲倦是流感的常見症狀。

fatigue.en: a feeling of being very tired

ex.en: My older brother is a very enthusiastic soccer fan.
ex.zh: 我哥哥是非常狂熱的足球迷。

ex.en: There were a lot of excited fans in the stadium.
ex.zh: 體育場裡有很多興奮的球迷。

ex.en: The fans all hope the club changes the manager.
ex.zh: 球迷都希望球隊換掉總教練。

fan.en: a person who likes a sport, team or person very much

ex.en: It's warm, so I turned on the electric fan.
ex.zh: 天氣很熱，所以我打開了電風扇。

ex.en: The ceiling fan keeps the room cool.
ex.zh: 吊扇讓房間保持涼爽。

fan.en: a machine or object that moves the air to make you feel cooler

ex.en: Reality and fantasy are hard to distinguish.
ex.zh: 現實和幻想是很難區分的。

ex.en: He lives in a world of fantasy.
ex.zh: 他住在一個奇幻世界裡。

ex.en: You're just comforting yourself with a fantasy!
ex.zh: 你這樣就是畫餅充飢！

fantasy.en: something imagined that is not real, often a pleasant dream

ex.en: Even with all his wealth and fame, he's unhappy.
ex.zh: 儘管有金錢和名譽，他還是不幸福。

ex.en: Despite adversity, the architect achieved worldwide fame.
ex.zh: 儘管有逆境，建築師還是獲得了享譽全球的榮譽。

ex.en: I don't care for wealth and fame.
ex.zh: 我不關心財富和名聲。

fame.en: the state of being known by many people

ex.en: "Drawing dragons and dotting in the eyes" is a fable.
ex.zh: 畫龍點睛是一則寓言故事。

ex.en: The fable of the tortoise and the hare teaches patience.
ex.zh: 龜兔賽跑的寓言教人要有耐心。

fable.en: a short story that teaches a lesson, often with animals

ex.en: Children watched the magician with fascination.
ex.zh: 孩子們看魔術師表演看得入迷。

ex.en: He has a lifelong fascination with space.
ex.zh: 他一輩子都對太空著迷。

fascination.en: the state of being very interested in something

ex.en: The statue of Hachiko, the faithful dog, stands in front of Shibuya Station.
ex.zh: 忠犬八公的雕像佇立在澀谷站前。

ex.en: He remained faithful to his wife throughout his life.
ex.zh: 他一生都對妻子忠誠。

ex.en: The dog was a faithful companion to the old man.
ex.zh: 那隻狗是老人忠實的伴侶。

faithful.en: staying loyal and true to a person or a belief

ex.en: She fainted when she saw blood.
ex.zh: 她一看到血就昏倒了。

ex.en: On hearing the news, she fainted.
ex.zh: 一聽到消息，她就昏倒了。

ex.en: I feel like I'm going to faint.
ex.zh: 我覺得我快昏倒了。

faint.en: to suddenly lose consciousness for a short time

ex.en: I felt faint after standing in the sun for an hour.
ex.zh: 在太陽底下站了一個小時後，我覺得頭暈。

ex.en: If you feel faint, sit down and put your head between your knees.
ex.zh: 如果覺得頭暈，就坐下來把頭放低到兩膝之間。

faint.en: feeling weak and as if you might fall down

ex.en: She gave a faint smile.
ex.zh: 她淡淡一笑。

ex.en: The sound of shouting grew faint.
ex.zh: 叫喊聲漸漸變弱了。

ex.en: After washing, the cat's fur is soft and fluffy, and has a faint scent.
ex.zh: 洗過澡後，貓咪的毛柔軟又蓬鬆，還有淡淡的香味。

ex.en: The story is not in accord with the facts.
ex.zh: 這個故事和事實不符。

ex.en: This account does not agree with the facts.
ex.zh: 這份說明和事實不符。

ex.en: Facts are stubborn things, but statistics are pliable.
ex.zh: 事實是頑固的，統計數字卻是可以操弄的。

fact.en: something that is known to be true

fact.zh: in fact / as a matter of fact：事實上、其實

ex.en: Those grapes look sweet, but in fact they're sour.
ex.zh: 那些葡萄看起來很甜，其實是酸的。

ex.en: As a matter of fact, I do speak Spanish.
ex.zh: 事實上，我會說西班牙文。

fact.en: used to say what is really true, often when it is different from what you expect

ex.en: It's all fake news.
ex.zh: 這全都是假新聞。

ex.en: Always check the source before sharing a story, or you may spread fake news.
ex.zh: 分享消息前一定要查證來源，不然可能會散播假新聞。

fake news.en: false stories that look like true reports and are spread to trick people

ex.en: Possibly the factory will be closed down next week.
ex.zh: 工廠下週可能會關閉。

ex.en: Automobiles are made in factories.
ex.zh: 汽車是在工廠裡製造的。

ex.en: This factory's productive capacity is 250 cars a week.
ex.zh: 這家工廠每週的產能是 250 輛車。

factory.en: a building where goods are made using machines

ex.en: The hotel has excellent sports facilities.
ex.zh: 這家飯店有很棒的運動設施。

ex.en: The company opened a new research facility.
ex.zh: 公司開設了一座新的研究中心。

facility.en: a place, building or equipment provided for a particular use

ex.en: A facilitator kept the workshop focused when the discussion drifted.
ex.zh: 討論偏離主題時，引導人員協助工作坊回到重點。

ex.en: The facilitator asked each department to suggest one solution.
ex.zh: 引導人員請各部門各提出一項解決方案。

facilitator.en: a person who helps a group work together and discuss things easily

ex.en: The workshop fabricates custom brackets for the production line.
ex.zh: 這間工坊為生產線加工客製化支架。

ex.en: The employee was dismissed for fabricating delivery records.
ex.zh: 這名員工因捏造出貨紀錄而遭到解雇。

fabricate.en: to make or build something, or to invent something false

ex.en: What is the fare from Osaka to Akita?
ex.zh: 從大阪到秋田的車費是多少？

ex.en: Taxi fares will go up next month.
ex.zh: 計程車費將在下個月漲價。

ex.en: How much is the bus fare?
ex.zh: 公車票價多少錢？

fare.en: the money you pay to travel on a bus, train or plane

ex.en: How far is it from here to the museum?
ex.zh: 這裡離博物館多遠？

ex.en: How far is it to the library from here?
ex.zh: 圖書館離這裡有多遠？

far.en: at or to a long distance

ex.en: Tim's motorbike is far more expensive than mine is.
ex.zh: 提姆的機車比我的貴多了。

ex.en: You smoke far too much. You should cut back.
ex.zh: 你菸抽得太多了，應該少抽一點。

far.en: used to make a comparison stronger

ex.en: School has started and I like it so far.
ex.zh: 開學了，目前感覺還不錯。

ex.en: So far, everything is going well.
ex.zh: 到目前為止，一切都很順利。

ex.en: The new software will facilitate communication between teams.
ex.zh: 新軟體能讓各團隊之間的溝通更順暢。

ex.en: Good lighting facilitates reading.
ex.zh: 良好的照明讓閱讀更輕鬆。

facilitate.en: to make something easier or help it happen

ex.en: Anna will facilitate today's workshop.
ex.zh: 今天的工作坊由安娜主持。

ex.en: A good leader facilitates discussion instead of dominating it.
ex.zh: 好的領導者會帶領討論，而不是主導發言。

facilitate.en: to lead a meeting or discussion and help people take part

ex.en: Blue is my favourite colour.
ex.zh: 藍色是我最喜歡的顏色。

ex.en: What is your favourite movie?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡的電影是什麼？

ex.en: This song has always been a favourite of mine.
ex.zh: 這首歌一直是我的最愛。

ex.en: The little girl is her grandmother's favourite.
ex.zh: 那個小女孩是她奶奶的心肝寶貝。

ex.en: Could you do me a favour and watch my bag?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我個忙，幫我看一下包包嗎？

ex.en: He asked a favour of his old friend.
ex.zh: 他請老朋友幫了他一個忙。

ex.en: She did me a big favour by driving me home.
ex.zh: 她開車送我回家，幫了我一個大忙。

ex.en: The new plan found favour with most of the staff.
ex.zh: 大部分員工都贊成這個新計畫。

ex.en: He tried to win the manager's favour.
ex.zh: 他努力想博得經理的好感。

ex.en: Most people favour a shorter work week.
ex.zh: 大多數人贊成縮短每週工時。

ex.en: The teacher was accused of favouring some students.
ex.zh: 老師被指責偏袒某些學生。

ex.en: Farming is hard work, especially in summer.
ex.zh: 務農很辛苦，尤其是在夏天。

ex.en: His family has been in farming for generations.
ex.zh: 他的家族世世代代都從事農業。

ex.en: The documentary about the ocean was fascinating.
ex.zh: 那部關於海洋的紀錄片非常有意思。

ex.en: She told us a fascinating story about her trip.
ex.zh: 她跟我們講了一個關於旅行的精彩故事。

ex.en: I find ancient history fascinating.
ex.zh: 我覺得古代史很迷人。

ex.en: The weather was favourable for sailing today.
ex.zh: 今天的天氣很適合航行。

ex.en: The new product received favourable reviews from customers.
ex.zh: 這項新產品得到顧客的好評。

ex.en: Most members were favourable to the idea of a longer break.
ex.zh: 大多數成員贊成延長休息時間的想法。

ex.en: The manager gave a favourable response to my request.
ex.zh: 經理對我的請求給了正面的回應。

ex.en: The accident was fatal for the driver.
ex.zh: 那場事故對駕駛來說是致命的。

ex.en: Some mushrooms can be fatal if you eat them.
ex.zh: 有些蕈類吃下去可能致命。

ex.en: Forgetting the password was a fatal mistake.
ex.zh: 忘記密碼是個致命的錯誤。

ex.en: A fatal error stopped the program.
ex.zh: 一個嚴重錯誤讓程式停了下來。

ex.en: She always wears fashionable clothes to the office.
ex.zh: 她總是穿著時髦的衣服上班。

ex.en: This neighborhood has become a fashionable place to live.
ex.zh: 這個社區已經變成一個時髦的居住地點。

ex.en: Short hair is very fashionable this year.
ex.zh: 短髮今年非常流行。

ex.en: This train is faster than the old one.
ex.zh: 這班火車比舊的那班更快。

ex.en: I need a faster computer for my work.
ex.zh: 我的工作需要一台更快的電腦。

ex.en: Can you walk a little faster? We are late.
ex.zh: 你能走快一點嗎？我們遲到了。

ex.en: The kids ran faster as the rain got heavier.
ex.zh: 雨越下越大，孩子們跑得更快了。

ex.en: The bag looked real, but it was fake.
ex.zh: 那個包包看起來像真的，其實是假的。

ex.en: He showed a fake ID at the door.
ex.zh: 他在門口出示了一張假證件。

ex.en: She gave me a fake smile and walked away.
ex.zh: 她對我假笑了一下就走開了。

ex.en: The expert said the painting was a fake.
ex.zh: 專家說這幅畫是贗品。

ex.en: Be careful, because many of those watches are fakes.
ex.zh: 要小心，因為那些手錶很多都是假貨。

ex.en: He faked a cough to avoid going to school.
ex.zh: 他假裝咳嗽，好不去上學。

ex.en: They faked the signature on the document.
ex.zh: 他們偽造了文件上的簽名。

ex.en: The little girl dressed up as a fairy with silver wings.
ex.zh: 小女孩扮成有銀色翅膀的小仙女。

ex.en: In the story, a fairy helps the poor farmer.
ex.zh: 故事裡，一位仙女幫助了貧窮的農夫。

ex.en: My daughter loves reading fairy tales before bed.
ex.zh: 我女兒喜歡睡前讀童話故事。

ex.en: Small fairy lights hung over the garden.
ex.zh: 花園上方掛著小小的仙女燈串。

ex.en: She could read his mood from his facial expression.
ex.zh: 她從他的臉部表情就能看出他的心情。

ex.en: The phone can unlock using facial recognition.
ex.zh: 這支手機可以用臉部辨識解鎖。

ex.en: She booked a facial at the spa for her birthday.
ex.zh: 她為了慶祝生日，在水療中心預約了臉部護理。

ex.en: A facial can help your skin feel fresh and clean.
ex.zh: 臉部護理可以讓皮膚感覺清爽乾淨。

ex.en: You look fabulous in that blue dress.
ex.zh: 你穿那件藍色洋裝看起來美極了。

ex.en: We had a fabulous time at the beach party.
ex.zh: 我們在海灘派對玩得超開心。

ex.en: The old book tells of a fabulous city made of gold.
ex.zh: 那本古書記載了一座傳說中由黃金打造的城市。

ex.en: Sailors once told fabulous tales about sea monsters.
ex.zh: 水手們曾經講述關於海怪的神話般故事。

failed.zh: 失敗、沒做到（fail 的過去式）

ex.en: He failed to arrive on time because of the traffic.
ex.zh: 他因為塞車而沒能準時抵達。

ex.en: The first plan failed, so we tried a different way.
ex.zh: 第一個計畫失敗了，所以我們試了別的方法。

ex.en: She failed the math exam and had to take it again.
ex.zh: 她數學考試不及格，必須重考。

ex.en: I failed my driving test the first time.
ex.zh: 我第一次路考沒有通過。

ex.en: It was a failed attempt, but we learned a lot from it.
ex.zh: 那是一次失敗的嘗試，但我們從中學到很多。

ex.en: The failed business left him with many debts.
ex.zh: 那間失敗的生意讓他背了許多債。

ex.en: They bought an old farmhouse in the countryside.
ex.zh: 他們在鄉下買了一棟老農舍。

ex.en: Smoke rose from the chimney of the farmhouse.
ex.zh: 農舍的煙囪冒出了煙。

ex.en: Who is the fastest runner in your class?
ex.zh: 你們班上跑最快的人是誰？

ex.en: This is the fastest way to get to the airport.
ex.zh: 這是去機場最快的方法。

ex.en: A long drought caused a terrible famine in the region.
ex.zh: 長期乾旱在該地區造成嚴重饑荒。

ex.en: Aid groups sent food to the areas hit by famine.
ex.zh: 救援團體把糧食送往遭受饑荒的地區。

ex.en: Red is the favoured color for gifts at the festival.
ex.zh: 紅色是這個節慶送禮時最受青睞的顏色。

ex.en: The favoured team was expected to win easily.
ex.zh: 被看好的那支球隊預期會輕鬆獲勝。

ex.en: The judge favoured the plan that cost the least.
ex.zh: 評審偏好花費最少的方案。

ex.en: Their mother favoured the youngest child, and the others noticed.
ex.zh: 他們的母親偏愛最小的孩子，其他人都看在眼裡。

ex.en: I could faintly hear music from the next room.
ex.zh: 我隱約聽到隔壁房間傳來音樂聲。

ex.en: She smiled faintly and said nothing.
ex.zh: 她淡淡地笑了笑，什麼也沒說。

ex.en: The history class discussed the rise of fascism in Europe.
ex.zh: 歷史課討論了法西斯主義在歐洲的興起。

ex.en: Many countries fought against fascism in World War II.
ex.zh: 許多國家在第二次世界大戰中對抗法西斯主義。

ex.en: The facade of the old theater was recently repaired.
ex.zh: 那座老劇院的正面最近修繕過了。

ex.en: Tourists took photos of the church facade.
ex.zh: 遊客們拍下了教堂的正面。

ex.en: His smile was only a facade to hide his worry.
ex.zh: 他的微笑只是掩飾擔憂的假象。

ex.en: Behind the calm facade, she felt very nervous.
ex.zh: 在平靜的外表下，她其實非常緊張。

ex.en: We walked through the forest on a path of fallen leaves.
ex.zh: 我們走在落葉鋪成的林間小路上。

ex.en: A fallen tree blocked the road after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨後，一棵倒下的樹擋住了道路。

ex.en: The snow has fallen all night long.
ex.zh: 雪下了一整夜。

ex.en: Prices have fallen sharply this year.
ex.zh: 今年物價大幅下降。

ex.en: The town built a monument to honor its fallen soldiers.
ex.zh: 鎮上建了一座紀念碑來紀念陣亡的士兵。

ex.en: They held a silent ceremony for the fallen heroes.
ex.zh: 他們為陣亡的英雄舉行了默哀儀式。

ex.en: The town is famed for its hot springs.
ex.zh: 這座小鎮以溫泉聞名。

ex.en: He is a famed chef who has written several cookbooks.
ex.zh: 他是著名的廚師，寫過好幾本食譜。

ex.en: History books describe him as a fascist who ruled by force.
ex.zh: 歷史書描述他是以武力統治的法西斯主義者。

ex.en: The film shows how a fascist rose to power.
ex.zh: 這部電影呈現一位法西斯主義者如何掌權。

ex.en: She wore a pair of faded blue jeans.
ex.zh: 她穿著一條褪色的藍色牛仔褲。

ex.en: The faded flowers were thrown away.
ex.zh: 凋謝的花被丟掉了。

ex.en: Most of the valley is rich farmland.
ex.zh: 這個山谷大部分是肥沃的農地。

ex.en: New houses are being built on former farmland.
ex.zh: 新房子正在原本的農地上興建。

ex.en: The train passed miles of flat farmland.
ex.zh: 火車經過了綿延數英里的平坦農田。

ex.en: His steps faltered as he climbed the last hill.
ex.zh: 他爬上最後一座山丘時腳步蹣跚。

ex.en: The economy began to falter last year.
ex.zh: 經濟在去年開始衰退。

ex.en: Her voice faltered as she read the sad letter.
ex.zh: 她讀著那封悲傷的信時，聲音顫抖了起來。

ex.en: He never faltered in his answer during the interview.
ex.zh: 面試時他的回答從未支吾遲疑。

ex.en: The Falklands are a group of islands in the South Atlantic.
ex.zh: 福克蘭群島是南大西洋上的一群島嶼。

ex.en: Penguins and seals live along the coast of the Falklands.
ex.zh: 企鵝和海豹棲息在福克蘭群島的海岸邊。

ex.en: The company is still dealing with the fallout from the mistake.
ex.zh: 公司仍在處理那個錯誤造成的後果。

ex.en: The political fallout of the scandal lasted for months.
ex.zh: 那樁醜聞的政治餘波持續了好幾個月。

ex.en: Scientists measured the fallout after the nuclear accident.
ex.zh: 科學家在核災後測量了放射性落塵。

ex.en: People were told to stay indoors to avoid the fallout.
ex.zh: 人們被告知要待在室內以避開落塵。

ex.en: Doctors suggest eating less fatty food.
ex.zh: 醫生建議少吃油膩的食物。

ex.en: Salmon is a fatty fish that is good for your heart.
ex.zh: 鮭魚是富含脂肪的魚，對心臟有益。

ex.en: The island has a rich fauna, including many rare birds.
ex.zh: 這座島有豐富的動物群，包括許多稀有鳥類。

ex.en: The book describes the flora and fauna of the rainforest.
ex.zh: 這本書介紹了雨林的動植物。

ex.en: The writer was famously shy and rarely gave interviews.
ex.zh: 那位作家出了名地害羞，很少接受訪問。

ex.en: The city is famously expensive for tourists.
ex.zh: 這座城市以對遊客來說物價昂貴而聞名。

ex.en: The two sisters got on famously from the first day.
ex.zh: 姊妹倆從第一天起就相處得非常融洽。

ex.en: The meeting went famously, and everyone was happy.
ex.zh: 會議進行得非常順利，大家都很滿意。

ex.en: The doctor asked for a faecal sample to test for infection.
ex.zh: 醫生要求採集糞便檢體來檢驗是否感染。

ex.en: Faecal bacteria in the river made the water unsafe to swim in.
ex.zh: 河裡的糞便細菌讓水不適合游泳。

ex.en: Large ships must stay in the fairway to avoid the shallow water.
ex.zh: 大型船隻必須留在航道內，以避開淺水區。

ex.en: The harbor workers marked the fairway with bright buoys.
ex.zh: 港口工人用亮色浮標標出航道。

ex.en: His drive landed in the middle of the fairway.
ex.zh: 他的開球落在球道的正中央。

ex.en: The ball rolled off the fairway and into the trees.
ex.zh: 球滾出了球道，進到樹林裡。

ex.en: The new plan was received favourably by most people.
ex.zh: 大多數人對這個新計畫反應良好。

ex.en: She compared favourably with the other candidates.
ex.zh: 她與其他應徵者相比毫不遜色。

ex.en: The crash caused two fatalities.
ex.zh: 這場車禍造成兩人死亡。

ex.en: Fatalities on this road have fallen since the new rules.
ex.zh: 新規定實施後，這條路上的死亡事故減少了。

ex.en: Pasta is the favored dish at our family dinners.
ex.zh: 義大利麵是我們家聚餐時最受青睞的菜。

ex.en: The favored team won the match easily.
ex.zh: 被看好的那支隊伍輕鬆贏得了比賽。

favored.zh: 偏愛、贊成（favor 的過去式）

ex.en: The teacher favored students who spoke up in class.
ex.zh: 老師偏愛在課堂上發言的學生。

ex.en: Most voters favored the new park plan.
ex.zh: 大多數選民贊成新的公園計畫。

ex.en: We walked farther than we had planned.
ex.zh: 我們走得比原本計畫的還要遠。

ex.en: The bus stop is farther down the road.
ex.zh: 公車站在這條路更前面一點。

ex.en: The farther shore of the lake was hidden in fog.
ex.zh: 湖的對岸籠罩在霧中。

ex.en: Which of the two towns is farther from here?
ex.zh: 這兩個小鎮哪一個離這裡更遠？

ex.en: The new design was favorably received by most customers.
ex.zh: 大多數顧客對新設計的反應很正面。

ex.en: Her results compare favorably with those of last year.
ex.zh: 她的成績和去年相比毫不遜色。

ex.en: The judge looked favorably on his request for more time.
ex.zh: 法官對他要求更多時間的請求持肯定的態度。

ex.en: The falcon dived from the sky to catch its prey.
ex.zh: 那隻隼從空中俯衝下來捕捉獵物。

ex.en: A trainer showed us how a falcon returns to his glove.
ex.zh: 馴鷹人示範了獵鷹如何飛回他的手套上。

ex.en: Please turn off the faucet when you brush your teeth.
ex.zh: 刷牙的時候請把水龍頭關上。

ex.en: The kitchen faucet is dripping again.
ex.zh: 廚房的水龍頭又在滴水了。

ex.en: He fixed the leaking faucet with a new washer.
ex.zh: 他換了新的墊圈，修好了漏水的水龍頭。

ex.en: He is a soccer fanatic who never misses a match.
ex.zh: 他是個足球狂熱者，從不錯過比賽。

ex.en: The shop attracts fitness fanatics.
ex.zh: 這家店吸引了健身狂熱者。

ex.en: She is fanatic about keeping her room clean.
ex.zh: 她對保持房間整潔十分狂熱。

ex.en: The team has fanatic fans all over the country.
ex.zh: 這支球隊在全國各地都有狂熱的球迷。

ex.en: They share a strong familial bond.
ex.zh: 他們之間有很強的家族情誼。

ex.en: Some diseases have a familial pattern.
ex.zh: 有些疾病具有家族遺傳的特性。

ex.en: Falling prices are good news for shoppers.
ex.zh: 價格下滑對購物者是好消息。

ex.en: He was hit by a falling branch during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨中他被掉落的樹枝砸到。

ex.en: Fidget toys were a fad that faded within a year.
ex.zh: 指尖玩具只是一時的流行，一年內就退燒了。

ex.en: Don't follow every diet fad you see online.
ex.zh: 別跟風網路上每一種流行的減肥法。

ex.en: The theater is showing a funny farce this month.
ex.zh: 劇院這個月在上演一齣好笑的鬧劇。

ex.en: The meeting turned into a farce when nobody knew the agenda.
ex.zh: 沒人知道議程，會議變成一場鬧劇。

ex.en: The story was a complete fabrication.
ex.zh: 那個故事完全是捏造的。

ex.en: He was fired for fabrication of data in his report.
ex.zh: 他因在報告中捏造數據而被開除。

ex.en: The factory focuses on the fabrication of metal parts.
ex.zh: 那家工廠專門製造金屬零件。

ex.en: Fabrication of the bridge took six months.
ex.zh: 那座橋的製造花了六個月。

ex.en: The pitcher threw a fastball down the middle.
ex.zh: 投手投出一記正中的快速球。

ex.en: He struck out the batter with a fastball.
ex.zh: 他用快速球三振了打者。

ex.en: He likes to fantasize about winning the lottery.
ex.zh: 他喜歡幻想中樂透。

ex.en: Children often fantasize about being superheroes.
ex.zh: 孩子常幻想自己是超級英雄。

ex.en: He dreams of traveling to faraway countries.
ex.zh: 他夢想著去遙遠的國家旅行。

ex.en: She told stories about a faraway land with tall mountains.
ex.zh: 她講著關於一個有高山的遙遠國度的故事。

ex.en: He had a faraway look in his eyes as he stared out the window.
ex.zh: 他望著窗外，眼神恍惚出神。

ex.en: He was falsely accused of stealing the money.
ex.zh: 他被誤指偷了那筆錢。

ex.en: The advertisement falsely claimed that the product was safe.
ex.zh: 那則廣告不實地宣稱產品是安全的。

ex.en: She falsely believed that the exam was cancelled.
ex.zh: 她誤以為考試取消了。

ex.en: It was a fateful decision that changed his life.
ex.zh: 那是一個改變他一生的決定性抉擇。

ex.en: On that fateful night, the two friends met for the first time.
ex.zh: 就在那個命運般的夜晚，兩位朋友第一次見面。

ex.en: The museum displays a facsimile of the original map.
ex.zh: 博物館展示了這張原始地圖的複製本。

ex.en: This book is a facsimile of the first printed edition.
ex.zh: 這本書是初版印刷本的複製版。

ex.en: Please send the signed form by facsimile.
ex.zh: 請以傳真寄出簽好名的表格。

ex.en: The old office still relied on facsimile to send documents.
ex.zh: 那間老辦公室仍靠傳真來送文件。

ex.en: He is failing math, so he needs extra help after school.
ex.zh: 他數學快不及格了，所以放學後需要額外輔導。

ex.en: The shop kept failing to attract customers, even after the sale.
ex.zh: 即使在特價之後，這家店還是一直吸引不了顧客。

ex.en: Impatience is his biggest failing as a manager.
ex.zh: 沒耐心是他身為主管最大的缺點。

ex.en: Everyone has a few failings, and that is perfectly normal.
ex.zh: 每個人都有一些缺點，這完全正常。

ex.en: She moved in with her son because of her failing health.
ex.zh: 因為健康日漸惡化，她搬去和兒子同住。

ex.en: The failing business was sold at a low price last spring.
ex.zh: 那間經營不善的公司去年春天以低價賣掉了。

ex.en: A fanfare of trumpets announced the arrival of the queen.
ex.zh: 一陣嘹亮的小號聲宣告女王駕到。

ex.en: The ceremony began with a short fanfare.
ex.zh: 典禮以一段簡短的號角聲開場。

ex.en: The new phone was launched with great fanfare.
ex.zh: 這款新手機在大肆宣傳下上市。

ex.en: She left the company quietly, without any fanfare.
ex.zh: 她悄悄離開了公司，沒有任何排場。

ex.en: I can't fathom why he would quit such a good job.
ex.zh: 我想不通他為什麼要辭掉這麼好的工作。

ex.en: It is hard to fathom how big the universe really is.
ex.zh: 宇宙到底有多大，實在很難理解。

ex.en: The water here is about six fathoms deep.
ex.zh: 這裡的水深大約是六英尋。

ex.en: The captain measured the depth in fathoms.
ex.zh: 船長以英尋為單位測量水深。

ex.en: The children drew fanciful pictures of flying cats.
ex.zh: 孩子們畫了異想天開的飛天貓圖畫。

ex.en: It's a fanciful idea, but it would never work.
ex.zh: 這是個異想天開的點子，但絕對行不通。

ex.en: They searched for the fabled city of gold.
ex.zh: 他們尋找傳說中的黃金城。

ex.en: The fabled sword was said to belong to a king.
ex.zh: 據說那把傳說中的劍屬於一位國王。

ex.en: He is fanatical about keeping his desk perfectly tidy.
ex.zh: 他對於保持桌面整齊到近乎狂熱。

ex.en: The team has some fanatical fans who travel everywhere.
ex.zh: 這支球隊有一些到處追隨的狂熱球迷。

ex.en: The driver was fatally injured in the crash.
ex.zh: 那名駕駛在車禍中受了致命傷。

ex.en: The plan was fatally flawed from the start.
ex.zh: 這個計畫從一開始就有致命的缺陷。

ex.en: The snake showed its long fangs.
ex.zh: 那條蛇露出長長的毒牙。

ex.en: The dog's sharp fang cut through the rope.
ex.zh: 狗尖銳的犬牙咬斷了繩子。

fading.zh: 褪色；逐漸消失（fade 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The colors on the old flag are fading in the sun.
ex.zh: 老旗子上的顏色在陽光下逐漸褪去。

ex.en: The music was fading as we walked away.
ex.zh: 我們走遠時，音樂聲漸漸變小。

ex.en: Fatherhood has made him more patient.
ex.zh: 當了爸爸讓他更有耐心。

ex.en: He enjoys the joys and challenges of fatherhood.
ex.zh: 他享受為人父的喜悅與挑戰。

ex.en: It is a fallacy that more expensive products are always better.
ex.zh: 越貴的產品一定越好，這是個謬論。

ex.en: The teacher showed us a logical fallacy in the argument.
ex.zh: 老師向我們指出這個論點中的邏輯謬誤。

ex.en: Farmers fatten the pigs before selling them.
ex.zh: 農夫在賣豬之前會先把牠們養肥。

ex.en: Rich desserts will fatten you up quickly.
ex.zh: 濃郁的甜點很快就會讓你變胖。

ex.en: Chickens were running around the farmyard this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上雞群在農家庭院裡四處跑。

ex.en: The children fed the ducks in the farmyard after lunch.
ex.zh: 午餐後孩子們在農家庭院餵鴨子。

ex.en: He was caught trying to falsify the company's records.
ex.zh: 他因試圖竄改公司的紀錄而被抓到。

ex.en: It is a crime to falsify a signature on a legal document.
ex.zh: 在法律文件上偽造簽名是犯罪。

faceless.zh: 無面目的；匿名的；無個性的

ex.en: The faceless crowd moved down the street in the rain.
ex.zh: 面目模糊的人群在雨中走過街道。

ex.en: Many people feel like a faceless number in a large company.
ex.zh: 許多人在大公司裡覺得自己只是一個沒有面目的數字。

ex.en: The fairground was full of music and the smell of popcorn.
ex.zh: 遊樂場裡充滿音樂聲和爆米花的香味。

ex.en: Every summer the town sets up a fairground near the river.
ex.zh: 每年夏天，鎮上都會在河邊搭起市集遊樂場。

ex.en: The report was full of falsehood and half-truths.
ex.zh: 這份報告充滿謊言和半真半假的說法。

ex.en: He was ashamed to be caught telling a falsehood.
ex.zh: 他被抓到說謊，覺得很羞愧。

ex.en: A zipper is a common type of fastener on jackets.
ex.zh: 拉鍊是外套上常見的一種扣件。

ex.en: The workers used a metal fastener to hold the boards together.
ex.zh: 工人用金屬扣件把木板固定在一起。

falkirk.zh: 福爾柯克（蘇格蘭中部城鎮）

ex.en: Falkirk is a town in central Scotland.
ex.zh: 福爾柯克是蘇格蘭中部的一座城鎮。

ex.en: The Falkirk Wheel is a rotating boat lift near the town.
ex.zh: 福爾柯克轉輪是該鎮附近的旋轉式船隻升降機。

ex.en: The students complained about the teacher's favoritism toward a few classmates.
ex.zh: 學生抱怨老師偏袒少數同學。

ex.en: A good manager treats everyone fairly and avoids favoritism.
ex.zh: 好主管對每個人公平，避免偏心。

ex.en: We had a fab time at the beach last weekend.
ex.zh: 上週末我們在海邊玩得超棒。

ex.en: That's a fab idea; let's do it!
ex.zh: 這主意太棒了，我們就這麼做吧！

ex.en: The falconer let the hawk fly high above the field.
ex.zh: 養鷹人讓老鷹飛到田野高空。

ex.en: A falconer must spend years training a bird.
ex.zh: 養鷹人得花好幾年訓練一隻鳥。

ex.en: We watched a falconer give a show at the festival.
ex.zh: 我們在慶典上看了一位養鷹人的表演。

ex.en: The children were fascinated by the magic show.
ex.zh: 孩子們被魔術表演迷住了。

ex.en: He is fascinated by stories about space travel.
ex.zh: 他對太空旅行的故事深深著迷。

ex.en: The farmer left the field fallow for a year.
ex.zh: 農夫讓那塊田休耕一年。

ex.en: Fallow land can recover its nutrients.
ex.zh: 休耕的土地能恢復養分。

ex.en: He is fastidious about keeping his desk clean.
ex.zh: 他對保持書桌整潔非常挑剔講究。

ex.en: The fastidious chef checked every dish before serving.
ex.zh: 一絲不苟的主廚上菜前檢查每道菜。

ex.en: A fawn stood quietly next to its mother in the forest.
ex.zh: 一隻小鹿安靜地站在森林裡母鹿的身旁。

ex.en: The fawn's spotted coat helps it hide among the leaves.
ex.zh: 小鹿身上的斑點毛皮可以讓牠藏身在葉子之間。

ex.en: Some of the staff fawn over the boss to get promoted.
ex.zh: 有些員工為了升遷而對老闆百般奉承。

ex.en: I don't like people who fawn on famous celebrities.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡那些對名人卑躬屈膝的人。

ex.en: The baby took a few faltering steps toward her mother.
ex.zh: 寶寶搖搖晃晃地朝媽媽走了幾步。

ex.en: He answered in a faltering voice, clearly nervous.
ex.zh: 他用顫抖遲疑的聲音回答，顯然很緊張。

ex.en: Religious fanaticism can divide a community.
ex.zh: 宗教狂熱可能使社區分裂。

ex.en: His fanaticism about football annoyed his family.
ex.zh: 他對足球的狂熱讓家人很困擾。

ex.en: He gave a facile answer to a hard question.
ex.zh: 他對一個難題給了膚淺的答案。

ex.en: It is facile to blame one person for everything.
ex.zh: 把一切都怪在一個人頭上是太草率的想法。

ex.en: Nothing seems to faze her.
ex.zh: 似乎沒有什麼事能讓她慌亂。

ex.en: The loud crowd didn't faze the young singer.
ex.zh: 吵雜的人群並沒有讓那位年輕歌手慌了手腳。

facing.zh: 面對；面向（face 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The house is facing the sea.
ex.zh: 這棟房子面向大海。

ex.en: She is facing a hard choice this week.
ex.zh: 她這週正面臨一個艱難的抉擇。

ex.en: The facing on the collar is made of silk.
ex.zh: 領口的貼邊是絲質的。

ex.en: The stone facing of the building protects the walls.
ex.zh: 這棟建築的石材飾面保護著牆壁。

ex.en: The meeting turned into a farcical argument about nothing.
ex.zh: 這場會議變成一場為芝麻小事吵來吵去的荒唐鬧劇。

ex.en: The trial was so farcical that people laughed out loud.
ex.zh: 那場審判荒唐到讓人笑出聲來。

ex.en: Please familiarise yourself with the safety rules.
ex.zh: 請先熟悉安全規則。

ex.en: The guide familiarised us with the city map.
ex.zh: 導遊讓我們熟悉了市區地圖。

ex.en: Her performance was faultless from start to finish.
ex.zh: 她的演出從頭到尾完美無缺。

ex.en: He speaks faultless English after years abroad.
ex.zh: 在國外住了多年，他的英文說得無可挑剔。

ex.en: The students accused the teacher of showing favouritism.
ex.zh: 學生指責老師偏心。

ex.en: Hiring a friend without an interview is clear favouritism.
ex.zh: 沒面試就僱用朋友顯然是徇私。

ex.en: Factional fights slowed the work of the committee.
ex.zh: 派系鬥爭拖慢了委員會的工作。

ex.en: The party is weak because of its factional divisions.
ex.zh: 這個政黨因為派系分裂而變得脆弱。

ex.en: The dog is known for its faithfulness to its owner.
ex.zh: 這隻狗以對主人的忠誠聞名。

ex.en: The translator valued faithfulness to the original text.
ex.zh: 譯者重視對原文的忠實。

ex.en: The old chair fell apart when I sat on it.
ex.zh: 我一坐上去，那張舊椅子就散掉了。

ex.en: My umbrella fell apart in the strong wind.
ex.zh: 我的雨傘在強風中解體了。

fall apart.en: to break into pieces because of being old or badly made

ex.en: After the bad news, she felt her life falling apart.
ex.zh: 聽到壞消息後，她覺得自己的生活正在崩解。

ex.en: Their friendship fell apart after the argument.
ex.zh: 那場爭吵之後，他們的友誼就破裂了。

fall apart.en: to lose control and be unable to deal with problems

ex.en: He broke the window, so now he has to face the music.
ex.zh: 他打破了窗戶，現在必須面對後果。

ex.en: It's time to face the music and tell Mom about the grade.
ex.zh: 是時候面對現實，把成績告訴媽媽了。

ex.en: She knew she'd done wrong and was ready to face the music.
ex.zh: 她知道自己做錯了，也準備好接受處罰。

face the music.en: to accept the unpleasant results of something you have done

ex.en: He fell behind the other runners after the first mile.
ex.zh: 跑完第一英里後，他落在其他跑者後面。

ex.en: Don't fall behind in your homework this week.
ex.zh: 這週別讓功課落後了。

ex.en: They fell behind on their rent last winter.
ex.zh: 他們去年冬天拖欠了房租。

fall behind.en: to fail to keep up with others or with payments

ex.en: The little girl fell down and started to cry.
ex.zh: 小女孩跌倒後哭了起來。

ex.en: Be careful not to fall down on the wet floor.
ex.zh: 小心別在濕地板上摔倒。

ex.en: The old wall fell down in the storm.
ex.zh: 那面舊牆在暴風雨中倒塌了。

ex.en: The tent fell down when the wind got strong.
ex.zh: 風變大時，帳篷就垮了。

ex.en: Her plan fell down because there was no money.
ex.zh: 她的計畫因為沒錢而失敗了。

ex.en: The argument falls down when you check the facts.
ex.zh: 一核對事實，這個論點就站不住腳。

ex.en: Don't fall for that old trick again.
ex.zh: 別又被那個老把戲騙了。

ex.en: He fell for the fake message and lost money.
ex.zh: 他被假訊息騙了，損失了錢。

ex.en: She fell for him the moment they met.
ex.zh: 她一見到他就愛上了他。

ex.en: I think he is falling for my sister.
ex.zh: 我覺得他正在愛上我姊姊。

ex.en: The boy fell off his bike and hurt his knee.
ex.zh: 男孩從腳踏車上摔下來，弄傷了膝蓋。

ex.en: A button fell off my coat on the bus.
ex.zh: 我外套的一顆鈕扣在公車上掉了。

ex.en: Sales fell off after the summer.
ex.zh: 夏天過後銷量下滑了。

ex.en: Interest in the show has fallen off lately.
ex.zh: 大家對這個節目的興趣最近減少了。

fall off.en: to become smaller in number or amount
